SIGNALS.name: Thariq
SIGNALS.summary: Thariq, who works on Claude Code, says Claude Code Desktop now understands its own capabilities better, such as spinning off subsessions, and calls it almost a v2.

SIGNALS.name: *Walter Bloomberg
SIGNALS.summary: Reported: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says the company will announce $2 billion in new European AI investments next week, on top of $8 billion invested over the past year.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind says Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available, aimed at hard problems across coding, enterprise workflows and cyber defense.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models yet, aimed at personal and professional agentic tasks; Muse Wonder is available now through the Meta Model API.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI Developers announce a beta of composer predictions in Codex for Pro users, which suggests your next message based on the conversation and how you write.

SIGNALS.name: DoT India
SIGNALS.summary: India's Department of Telecommunications says ITU's AI for Good initiative will be inaugurated in New Delhi on 9 October as part of IMC 2026.
